note: PUBLIC-SAFE EXAMPLE. The real seed lives at <control_root>/context-read/shared_terms.seed.v0.json and is Owner-placed; the terms below are placeholders and the project codes are not real ones. The seed declares a term shared before the graph has shown it in two projects — it never removes a term, and it never invents evidence: `projects` is where the term was actually seen, so a row without at least one project code is refused. `workflow_terms` is a plain list of the words that come from the task tracker's own state machine and notifications rather than from this estate's subject matter; it marks a registered term's category and registers nothing on its own. The generated registry (<control_root>/context-read/shared_terms.v0.json) is derived from this file plus the graph index and may be regenerated at any time.
